name: call_plugin
description: Invoke one of a plugin's own declared tools (from get_plugin_capabilities), to actually answer the customer's request or gather what you need to build a scene/automation. Use the result the way you'd use any other tool's result -- relay it, or feed it into further steps.

tool_name.description: The exact tool name from get_plugin_capabilities' tools list -- never invented.

args.description: Arguments for the plugin tool, as described by its entry in get_plugin_capabilities' tools list. Omit or leave empty for tools that need nothing.
